# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest released version of `odin-engine`.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not disclose a suspected vulnerability in a public issue or
discussion.

Use GitHub's **Security** tab and select **Report a vulnerability** to open a
private vulnerability report with the maintainers. Include:

- the affected Odin version;
- the affected component;
- reproduction steps or a proof of concept;
- the expected impact; and
- any suggested mitigation.

The maintainers will assess the report, coordinate remediation, and publish a
GitHub Security Advisory when disclosure is appropriate.

## Scope

This policy covers code distributed from this repository and the
`odin-engine` package on PyPI. Report vulnerabilities in third-party
dependencies to their respective maintainers unless Odin's use of the
dependency creates the vulnerability.
